summary: Sends a chat reply back for rewriting when it contains an em dash or an en dash.
doc: This Stop hook reads the reply before it ends and blocks it when the reply contains an em dash, en dash, horizontal bar, minus sign, escaped spelling of one, or `' -- '` used as a dash. The hook sends the model back to rewrite the reply with a period, comma, colon, or parentheses. It pairs with no-em-dash, which covers files and shell commands. To quote text that contains a dash, put it in a fenced code block, an inline backtick span, or a '>' blockquote. The hook blocks at most once per turn.
